name: ibis Styles Bangkok Sukhumvit 4
short_description: A 133-room design-economy hotel near Nana BTS with a 4.6/5 ALL Rating (638 reviews), rooftop bar with 270-degree views, and a swimming pool.
ai_summary: ibis Styles Bangkok Sukhumvit 4 is a short walk from Nana BTS Skytrain station, sharing its address with the adjacent Novotel Bangkok Sukhumvit 4. The 133-room property holds a 4.6/5 ALL Rating from 638 reviews. Rooms are designed by a local Thai interior designer, and facilities include a swimming pool, fitness centre, and a rooftop bar with 270-degree views of Bangkok. An on-demand drop-off shuttle service is available. Standard ALL elite benefits apply for Accor loyalty members.

elite_benefits: Welcome drink for ALL Silver members and above, per programme terms
Room upgrades for ALL Diamond and Platinum members, subject to availability
Early check-in and late check-out for ALL Diamond members, subject to availability

pros: 133 rooms with a strong 4.6/5 ALL Rating from 638 reviews
Rooftop bar with 270-degree Bangkok views, plus a swimming pool — unusual amenity level for an economy-tier ibis
Short walk to Nana BTS station and an on-demand shuttle service
cons: Sukhumvit Soi 4 area has a mixed nightlife/red-light reputation that some travellers may want to be aware of
research_highlights: Rooftop bar with 270-degree views, swimming pool
